run.requirements: Direct Stock Token and USDG custody with a minimal future Delta LP adapter path

summary.building: Direct Stock Token and USDG custody with a manually operated synchronous adapter extension point
summary.topRisk: An incomplete Delta entry and exit lifecycle can strand collection backing
summary.mustDecideFirst: Bind the exact INJOH token, Delta product, pool, conversion route, and complete redemption lifecycle before Delta activation
summary.watchOutFor: Stock Token dividends are reinvested through the onchain multiplier rather than paid separately

risks.title: External-call lifecycle risk
risks.detail: Adapter calls require reentrancy protection, measured receipts, and cleared temporary allowances

risks.title: Ownership handoff risk
risks.detail: Two-step registry ownership must be accepted before production activation

risks.title: Restricted-holder incompatibility
risks.detail: Production exposure requires a counsel-approved holder eligibility policy

risks.title: Multiplier double counting
risks.detail: The official per-token price feed already includes the Stock Token multiplier

risks.title: Incomplete entry and exit lifecycle
risks.detail: The exact product, pool, conversion route, custody, and redemption semantics are not fully bound

risks.title: Two-asset and streamed-reward accounting
risks.detail: Exits may return INJOH and WETH while WETH rewards can remain streamed

preCodingDecisions.title: Delta activation bindings
preCodingDecisions.detail: Exact INJOH token, product, pool, route, ABI, addresses, runtime hashes, caps, and exit semantics are required before activation

requirementsCorrections.detail: Stock Token dividends are reinvested through uiMultiplier rather than separately paid to the sleeve
USDG is a direct holding in the MVP and must not be described as a yield sleeve
The concrete Delta product, INJOH token, pool, conversion route, and complete exit lifecycle are not supplied

openQuestions: Unresolvable from current requirements and public sources: which exact Delta product and INJOH/WETH pool the collection will use
